name: Cyprus

related_people.name: Bar-Jesus
related_people.role: the sorcerer of this island struck blind for opposing Paul

related_people.name: Barnabas
related_people.role: a Levite of this island, who led the first mission through it

related_people.name: Mark
related_people.role: assisted Paul and Barnabas as they crossed this island

related_people.name: Mnason
related_people.role: a disciple of this island of long standing, who hosted Paul

related_people.name: Sergius Paulus
related_people.role: the island's proconsul, who believed after Elymas was struck blind

description: A Mediterranean island, Barnabas's homeland (Acts 4:36), where some believers scattered by persecution first preached to Greeks as well as Jews (Acts 11:19-20). Barnabas and Saul made it the first stop of their missionary journey, confronting the sorcerer Bar-Jesus and seeing the Roman proconsul Sergius Paulus believe (Acts 13:4-12); Barnabas and his cousin Mark later returned there together after parting ways with Paul (Acts 15:39).
